chapters.title: Elders for Crete
chapters.summary: Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders of good character who hold firmly to sound teaching and can correct those who oppose it.

chapters.title: The grace that teaches
chapters.summary: Older and younger believers are taught how to live. The grace of God has appeared, teaching us to live soberly and godly while we wait for Christ's appearing.

chapters.title: Saved by His mercy
chapters.summary: Be ready for every good work and gentle toward all. God saved us, not by our works, but by His mercy through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
